definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of dividing one number by another.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{算|ざん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{割|わ}り{算|ざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To calculate the ratio using division.

notes:
{割|わ}り{算|ざん} is composed of ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (to divide) + ⟦{算|さん}→算：noentry⟧ (calculation). Used mainly in math education and everyday arithmetic.

HOW TO READ DIVISION:
- 12⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧3⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4: 12 divided by 3 is 4
- The verb ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ is used for "divided by"

FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS:
- ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧: addition (+)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}→引き算：05333_hikizan⟧: subtraction (−)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{算|ざん}→掛け算：05334_kakezan⟧: multiplication (×)
- {割|わ}り{算|ざん}: division (÷)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{切|き}れる→割り切れる：27836_warikireru⟧: divisible (no remainder)
- ⟦{割|わ}り{切|き}れない→割り切れる：27836_warikireru⟧: indivisible; also figuratively "hard to accept"
- ⟦{余|あま}り→余り：17255_amari⟧: remainder
